messages.author: 47ca46208a81ec5e
messages.subject: Base R plotting tutorial script
parts:
Hi all,

Just a reminder that tomorrow I’ll be presenting a tutorial on making high quality plots using base R graphics from 10am to 11am in Wickson 2124. A regular hour-long work session will take place afterwards.

The presentation will be interactive, and will be geared toward beginner to intermediate R users. I’ve attached the script to this email, and it can also be downloaded from here: http://michaeljkoontz.weebly.com/teaching.html Bring your laptop and follow along to get the most out of the presentation. All ability levels welcome!

See you tomorrow,
Mike
